title: KG-AST for Cheaper CI/CD: Budgeted Test Selection and AI Bug Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.06950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous integration and AI-assisted review spend the same budget on every commit, although few commits introduce bugs. We study KG-AST, which scores each commit risk from git history and code-graph features before heavy tests or AI review run, so the budget goes to the riskiest commits first, and which hands the AI reviewer only a graph slice around the change. On 155 open-source projects in 11 languages, a single cross-language model trained on other projects ranks commits so that heavy testing of the riskiest 20% covers 49-64% of bug-introducing commits depending on the language, against 20% for random selection and 40-55% for testing the biggest change first.   Every language beats the biggest-change baseline, by 3.8 to 13.2 points. In 20 Java projects the gain at a 20% budget is 15.1 points (64.6% vs 49.5%, 95% interval +11.6 to +18.4), and the model wins in 19 of the 20 projects. translated_title: 面向更经济CI/CD的KG-AST：预算化测试选择与AI缺陷审查
translated_abstract: 持续集成与AI辅助审查在每个提交上花费相同的预算，尽管只有少数提交会引入缺陷。我们研究了KG-AST，它在运行重型测试或AI审查之前，基于git历史和代码图特征为每个提交进行风险评分，从而使预算优先分配给风险最高的提交，并且只向AI审查者提供变更周围的图切片。在11种语言的155个开源项目上，一个在其他项目上训练的单一跨语言模型对提交进行排序，使得对风险最高的20%提交进行重型测试即可覆盖49-64%的引入缺陷的提交（因语言而异），相比之下随机选择仅覆盖20%，优先测试最大变更的策略覆盖40-55%。每种语言都比最大变更基线高出3.8至13.2个百分点。在20个Java项目中，20%预算下的增益为15.1个百分点（64.6%对49.5%，95%置信区间为+11.6至+18.4），且模型在20个项目中的19个项目上获胜。大约十二个训练项目就足够了。
tldr: KG-AST利用git历史和代码图特征对提交进行风险评分，优先将测试与AI审查预算分配给最可能引入缺陷的提交，在11种语言的155个开源项目上显著优于随机选择和最大变更优先基线。
en_tdlr: KG-AST scores commit risk from git history and code-graph features to prioritize test and AI review budgets on the riskiest commits, significantly outperforming random selection and biggest-change-first baselines across 155 open-source projects in 11 languages.
